name: Agenta
summary: Open-source, self-hostable team workspace for building agents by chat, with tool permissions and approvals, sandboxed sessions, tracing and Slack/WhatsApp/Telegram access.
description: Agenta describes itself as a multi-user agent workspace for non-coding work (IT ops, GTM, HR, support). Agents get their own sandboxed computer and browser, 1,000+ integrations and MCP servers, schedules and event triggers, versioned prompts/skills/tools, run traces with cost, and evaluations. Bring your own model keys or a ChatGPT subscription. Agenta Cloud: Hobby free (daily credits), Starter $29/month, Business $299/month, Enterprise custom; the self-hosted open-source edition (Docker Compose) is free. Code is MIT except `ee/` directories. Latest release v0.124.2 (2026-10-25). Has llms.txt, a public REST API, OpenAPI and a Python SDK.
license: MIT (ee/ directories under a separate license)
